Class EpidemyCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.AdventureCard
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.adventurecards.EpidemyCard
public class EpidemyCard extends AdventureCard
Represents a specific type of adventure card called "Epidemy Card". Triggers events related to the removal of crew members from cabins based on interconnectivity of cabin tiles on the game board.

  • Method Details

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard()
      Overrides the drawCard method to perform additional functionality specific to the EpidemyCard. Calls the superclass method to change the game state and update the current player. Prints a message indicating the card drawn and its effects on the game. Invokes the checkRequirements method to assess the impact of interconnected cabins on crew members.
      Overrides:
      drawCard in class AdventureCard

    • checkInterconnectedCabin

      public void checkInterconnectedCabin()
      Checks and updates the list of cabins on a ship to ensure only interconnected cabins remain. Identifies isolated cabins that lack any neighboring cabins (north, south, east, or west) and removes them from the list of cabin coordinates.

    • checkRequirements

      public void checkRequirements()
      Verifies whether the current player's ship has interconnected cabins. If cabins are not interconnected, proceeds to check the next player. If cabins are interconnected, sets the state to apply the effect and triggers it. Outputs the process and decisions to the console.
      Overrides:
      checkRequirements in class AdventureCard

    • applyEffect

      public void applyEffect()
      Removes specific tokens (astronaut, brown aliens, purple aliens) from the tiles on the current player's ship board, based on the coordinates stored in coordinatesOfAllCabins. Clears the coordinates after processing and transitions to the next player. Overrides the base implementation to apply the custom effect of the EpidemyCard. Validation on the current state is handled by the superclass.
      Overrides:
      applyEffect in class AdventureCard
